senses.gloss: m. (אבש = יבש) something dried; parched or dried ears of grain.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 7b">Meg. 7ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 39b">Pes. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>קמחא דא׳</he> flour of roasted ears.
<cite ref="Pesachim 40a">Ib. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>חצבא דאבשו׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>אבי׳</he>) a basin wherein ears are roasted.
